ns2:section.sectionText: The course proposes a global study of the Caribbean region experiences with colonialism, economic crises, tax-havens, tourism, anti-corruption mobilizations, hurricanes, earthquakes and disaster capitalism. All of this will allow students to have a better understanding of the current sociopolitical problems and challenges taking place in the Caribbean, while shedding light on broader global dynamics of vulnerability, economic and financial crisis, and the climate crisis. Finally, this course aims to create a space to think about decolonial futures.
